title: 网络学习的利弊
text: “现在的网课真的太方便了！”我的朋友这样告诉我。他认为只要有电脑，就能学习任何知识。这种看法在现代社会很普遍。网络课程确实节省了大量时间。我们不需要在路上浪费精力。即使工作很忙，也能利用碎片时间进步。此外，学习成本通常比较低。许多高质量资源是免费的。然而，这种方式存在明显问题。缺乏面对面交流会让学生感到孤独。学习过程中很容易分心。即使有好的老师，缺乏监督也会导致效率降低。很多学生在听到复杂内容时，无法立刻提问。这影响了对知识的理解。因此，我们应该结合两种模式。将线上资源与线下讨论结合起来。这样才能达到最好的效果。只有坚持自律，学习才能成功。

questions.prompt: Who told the narrator that online courses are very convenient?
According to the text, what problem can arise from a lack of face-to-face communication in online learning?
What does the text say about the cost of many high-quality online resources?
options: They cost the same as offline courses

questions.prompt: What problem does the text mention about students who encounter complex content online?
options: They are removed from the class

questions.prompt: What solution does the text propose at the end for achieving the best learning outcome?
options: Combining online resources with offline discussion

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 是…的
patterns.explanation: Used to emphasise when, where, how, or by whom a past action happened. The 是 introduces the emphasised element; 的 closes the structure.
